h1: Criminal Defense Lawyer Marketing for the Call After an Arrest
lede: Criminal defense lawyer marketing lives and dies in the hours after an arrest. Vincere builds campaigns around charge type, court location and round-the-clock intake, so your firm is the one that answers when a family is searching at 2 a.m. You see retained clients and cost per retained case, not vanity metrics.

answer.question: How do criminal defense lawyers get more clients?
answer.text: Criminal defense lawyers get more clients by being visible the moment someone is arrested or charged, usually through Google Local Services Ads, paid search and the map pack, and by answering around the clock. Charge-specific pages, strong reviews and fast consultation booking turn those urgent searches into paid retainers.

market.title: Urgency runs the whole funnel
market.text: Most defense searches happen within hours or days of an arrest, often late at night or on weekends. A firm that only answers during business hours loses a large share of its best leads.

market.title: The caller is often not the client
market.text: Parents, spouses and friends frequently make the first call while the accused is in custody. Messaging and intake have to speak to a worried family member as well as the defendant.

market.title: Charge type drives case value
market.text: A first-offense misdemeanor, a felony drug charge and a federal white collar matter differ enormously in fee and complexity. Campaigns should separate them so budget follows the cases your firm wants.

market.title: Privacy shapes behavior
market.text: People facing charges rarely ask friends for a referral and often search privately. Reviews, clear fee conversations and a discreet first contact carry unusual weight.

sections.h2: Criminal defense lawyer marketing built around charge types
paragraphs: A generic "criminal lawyer" campaign mixes shoplifting, domestic violence, drug possession, theft and felony assault into one budget, and the cheapest clicks usually win. Vincere splits your marketing by charge type and court, so a DUI search, a probation violation search and a federal indictment search each land on a page written for that situation. That lets us fund the matters your firm prices well and wants more of, and pull back on low-fee charges that fill the calendar without moving revenue.

Geography matters just as much. Defense clients search by county and courthouse, and your ability to appear in a specific jurisdiction is a real selling point. We build location pages around the courts you actually practice in, not every city in the state. Your free plan shows local click costs, LSA competition and how crowded the map pack is for each charge type, then recommends where to launch first and what a retained case should cost.

Arrests do not follow office hours. Paid search schedules, LSA availability settings and call routing all need to match when your prospects actually search. We set ad schedules so budget is live when bookings spike, route calls to a person rather than a voicemail box, and give after-hours callers a clear next step. For many defense firms, simply answering between 9 p.m. and 7 a.m. changes results more than any new ad channel.

Families searching late at night also want quick answers: how bail works, whether they can visit, what happens at arraignment. Clear, plainly written pages on those questions help your firm rank in search and get named in AI answers from ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews. They also build trust before the first call, which matters when someone is choosing a lawyer in a stressful moment and has never hired one before.

Vincere is your single marketing partner. We connect the specialist teams for LSA, PPC, SEO, your website and any traditional media, and keep them on one plan and one set of numbers. You deal with one point of contact instead of juggling vendors who each claim credit for the same call. We handle coordination, reporting and the hard conversations about which channels are not pulling their weight.

Your client dashboard tracks spend by channel, calls, consultations booked and cost per retained case in real time. Defense firms often find that one charge type or one county produces most of their profitable retainers while another burns money on calls that never pay a fee. Seeing that in one place lets you shift budget quickly, which matters in a practice where demand can swing with local enforcement patterns.

channels.why: Criminal defense is an LSA category, and those ads often sit above everything else when someone searches after an arrest. Responsiveness settings reward firms that answer quickly, including after hours.
Search ads let you target specific charges and courthouses and schedule spend for nights and weekends. Negative keywords filter out people looking for inmate lookups or court records.
Charge type and county pages build steady organic and map pack visibility at a lower long-run cost. Reviews play an outsized role because referrals are rare in this practice.
24/7 call coverage, jail call handling and fast fee conversations decide whether an urgent lead becomes a paid retainer. We fix these before scaling spend.
Worried families ask AI assistants how bail works or what happens at arraignment. Well-structured answers on your site help your firm get cited in those replies.
A fast, mobile-first site with click-to-call on every page matters when most visitors are on a phone in a hurry. Pages for each charge and court convert better than one general page.

intake.h2: Criminal defense intake that never sleeps
intake.text: Defense leads decay fast. A family that cannot reach you tonight will hire whoever answers. We set up true 24/7 coverage, whether that is your own on-call rotation or a trained answering service with clear escalation rules. Scripts cover the charge, custody status, next court date and who is paying, without giving legal advice. Follow-up happens by text and call within minutes, consult slots are bookable online, and fee agreements can be signed electronically. We also set rules for jail calls and collect callbacks so none are lost overnight.

faqs.q: What is the best marketing for criminal defense lawyers?
faqs.a: The best marketing for criminal defense lawyers usually combines Google Local Services Ads, paid search by charge type and local SEO, all backed by 24/7 intake. Because arrests happen at all hours, being reachable matters as much as being visible. A free market plan shows which channels fit your courts and fees.

faqs.q: Should a criminal defense firm answer calls 24/7?
faqs.a: Yes, for most defense firms 24/7 answering is one of the highest-return changes available. Many arrest-related searches happen at night and on weekends, and callers usually hire the first firm that responds. That coverage can come from an on-call attorney, staff rotation or a trained answering service.

faqs.q: How do I market to family members of someone arrested?
faqs.a: Write pages and ads that speak directly to a parent or spouse trying to help, with plain answers on bail, visitation and first court dates. Make it easy to call or text immediately. Intake scripts should confirm who is paying and gather the defendant's information without delay.

faqs.q: Is SEO worth it for criminal defense attorneys?
faqs.a: SEO is worth it for many criminal defense attorneys because it lowers long-term cost per retained case as click prices rise. The most useful pages target a specific charge in a specific county or court. Reviews and a complete Google Business Profile drive much of the map pack visibility.

faqs.q: Can criminal defense lawyers advertise case results?
faqs.a: It depends on your state bar's rules, and many states require disclaimers or restrict how past results are presented. Vincere drafts copy with rules like ABA Model Rule 7.1 in mind and flags claims for your review. Your firm should confirm final compliance with your own state's requirements.

faqs.q: How do I stop getting low-value criminal leads?
faqs.a: Split campaigns by charge type, add negative keywords for record searches and inmate lookups, and write pages that are clear about the matters you handle. Qualifying questions at intake also help. Tracking cost per retained case by charge shows exactly where low-value leads come from.

faqs.q: How is criminal defense lawyer marketing measured?
faqs.a: Criminal defense lawyer marketing should be measured by retained clients and cost per retained case, broken out by channel and charge type. Clicks and calls alone can hide expensive, low-fee work. Your Vincere dashboard shows spend, calls, consultations and retained cases live.
